units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 230px head-to-sole ready silhouette and chest dimensions. Planted boots provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: Eight original masters preserved, seven used. Full articulated maul grip/lift idle, overhead swing/recovery, hit recoil, two-handed shaft brace, battle cry, grounded collapse and reciprocal gait. Corrective foreground-leg originals cross the reed skirt; first near-leg attempt rejected. Fixed master scales retain head/chest dimensions without individual pose deformation. All 48 original poses reviewed in Godot at 128px battle reference height: distinct grip, elbow, shoulder and knee motion; full weapon margins and grounded body/maul collapse, no joined sprites.
